column1:
2041-00-001-0001
State Transport
Tribunal
(Establishment and
Committed
Expenditure)
column7:
Augmentation in
provision of ₹39.20 lakh
was the net effect of
increase of ₹ 40.65lakh
and decrease by re-
appropriation of
₹1.45 lakh. Increase was
attributed to transport
allowances, medical
allowance, travelling
allowance, office
expenses, telephone and
legal charges in the light
of Hon'ble court.
Decrease was attributed
to anticipated saving.
Reasons for final saving
have not been intimated
(July 2025).
